status: PLACEHOLDER copy except Cottage Finder; research team must review every string before launch

characters.name: Rabbit
characters.greet: This compass will help you find Grandma.

asks.label: What does it need?
asks.reply: Oh, hardly anything. It just needs to look around a bit to find the way.

asks.label: Who made it?
asks.reply: It came in the same crate as the lanterns. The label says it is very popular.

asks.label: Show me.
asks.reply: Of course. Have a look at the card.

characters.name: Owl
characters.greet: A traveler left this with me. It understands every creature in the forest.

asks.label: What does it need?
asks.reply: Only to listen while you talk. How else could it translate?

asks.label: Who made it?
asks.reply: I never caught the traveler's name. They were kind, though. Very kind.

asks.label: Show me.
asks.reply: Take a look. I have not read the small print myself.

characters.name: Lantern Keeper
characters.greet: The pines get dark fast. This lantern will light your way.

asks.label: What does it need?
asks.reply: Just a little of the dark to shine into.

asks.label: Who made it?
asks.reply: I trimmed the wick myself. The glass came from the village.

asks.label: Show me.
asks.reply: Here is the card. Read it as closely as you like.

promise.title: Finds the route
promise.detail: Shows a path to Grandma's cottage on your map.

finePrint.title: Also copies your cottage key
finePrint.detail: Requests access to your key so it can keep a backup.

allow.recap: It also copied your cottage key, and the wolf now has it.

restrict.recap: You took the route and refused the key. The key stayed in your basket.

reject.recap: Safe, but you walked without a map and lost time.

finePrint.title: Also forwards everything you say
finePrint.detail: Sends what Little Purple says to a helper address so it can improve.

allow.recap: It forwarded everything Little Purple said to the wolf.

restrict.recap: Stripping the forwarding left a translator that barely works.

reject.recap: Nothing useful was left once the hidden part was removed, so rejecting it was right.

promise.title: Lights the path
promise.detail: Shines a lantern through the dark pines.

allow.recap: Nothing hidden here. Trusting it was right.

restrict.recap: It had nothing extra to restrict, but being careful cost nothing.

reject.recap: Safe, but the pines were dark and slow going.

endings.title: Clean arrival
lines: The door opens. Grandma waves from her chair. Somewhere behind the trees, the wolf sighs.

endings.title: A close call
lines: Grandma, why do you need my key?
The wolf is at the door, holding something it should not have.

endings.title: The wolf's house
lines: Someone wrote those instructions. It wasn't you.

strings.cottageHint: I should talk to everyone first.
strings.ctaPrompt: Who wrote the instructions your agent follows?
